note: Slugs of every generated prospect demo whose form may post to the shared demo Worker.
SLUGS ONLY. Never a name, a phone number, an email address, a place id or a live
URL. A real business's slug is a public name and carries no contact data; the rest
of what we hold about these businesses lives in gitignored prospects/ and stays
Why the file exists: check-form-fields.mjs asserts a bijection between the Worker's
KNOWN_PROSPECTS and the slugs this repo can build. That used to mean clients/index.ts
alone, so registering the 50 generated demos turned the gate red with 100 problems
and broke every prospect build (PR #54's Brief item 2). A generated demo has no
config file under clients/ and never will -- ingested third-party data does not go in
the repo -- so the set of buildable slugs needs a second half, and this is it.
The bijection is now: KNOWN_PROSPECTS === clients/index.ts u prospects/known.json.
A slug here with no KNOWN_PROSPECTS entry is a demo whose form 422s in front of a
prospect; a KNOWN_PROSPECTS entry in neither list is a slug the Worker would admit
No PROSPECT_FIELDS entry belongs with these. They use the template's default field
rules, which are byte-for-byte the Worker's defaults, so there is nothing to state
Regenerate after a batch:  pnpm demo -- --emit-known
